claim: Implemented operations below have been executed in the Linux/amd64 test environment; image/MP4 output quality is not expert validated.

operators.input: params.from frame stage, zoom_start, zoom_end, pan_x, pan_y, contrast, saturation

operators.caps: 40 sorted elements; text, pill, rect, line, progress, reticle, border
16x16 sampled luma; cut heuristic is not camera reconstruction
3x3 occupancy proposals; no semantic subject detection

operators.input: params.from frame stage and optional audio/score.wav
params.input workspace-local MP4 or staged input

operators.caps: syntactic bounds only, not visual collision checks
only workspace or staged input paths

security_contract.allowed: declared fixed operators and parameters only
security_contract.not_allowed: arbitrary code execution, dynamic plugin loading, shell, network downloads, credential access, social publishing
security_contract.input_policy: explicit ingest; no overwrite; path traversal and symlink rejection
security_contract.runtime_policy: use OCI container/VM, no network, least privilege; untrusted media decoding still has risk
